title: Login activity
search: Search loaded users by name or ID
noMatches: No matching loaded users. You can load more users.
notice: Reads retained ActivityLog records and the current Redis session index. Login logging is best effort; missing or previously purged data cannot be recovered.
failuresNotice: Failed-login history is not collected. Failure counts below represent only events actually stored; zero does not prove no login failures.
observationNotice: Activity within 5 minutes means the last observed authenticated request (updated at most once per 60 seconds). It does not guarantee online presence, a current connection or device identity.
historyUnavailable: Activity history is unavailable because the database cannot be read.
historyPartial: The query limit was reached. Charts and totals cover only the latest retrieved login events.
sessionsUnavailable: Sessions cannot be read because Redis is unavailable.
sessionsUnknown: The user session index is missing. This does not prove zero valid sessions.
sessionsPartial: Some session metadata is missing or invalid. Only verified sessions are shown; the total is unknown.
hours: Login successes by hour of day (UTC)
recentNotice: Shows up to 100 latest activities in the selected window, including non-login activity.
emptyEvents: No retained activity in this window.
emptySessions: No valid sessions verified in the index.
nativeDenied: Keystone denied permission to read the user directory.
directoryUnavailable: The Keystone user directory is unavailable.
notFound: The selected user does not exist. Reload the user directory.
unavailable: Unable to read monitoring data. Please retry.
sessionsNotice: Expired, blacklisted and absolute-lifetime-exceeded sessions are excluded. Effective expiry is the earlier of refresh expiry and absolute expiry from the original start. Live provider-token validity is not checked.
searchNotice: Search applies to loaded users. Load more to retrieve the next directory page.
